title: Elixir of Gnomish Ingenuity

sources.title: Knock
markers: | description = Unlock an object that is held shut by a mundane lock.

summary: Until Long Rest, gain Sleight of Hand proficiency and one cast of Knock.

fields.Drink: Bonus Action. Consume one bottle. Until Long Rest, gain Sleight of Hand proficiency and one cast of Knock.
fields.Acquisition: Trade gnome blood to Araj Oblodra in Moonrise Towers or the Lower City.
fields.Stacking: Araj’s elixirs stack with ordinary elixirs and other Araj elixirs.
fields.Knock: Action. Open a mundane lock from up to 60 ft, regardless of its lockpicking DC. Some locks have a status that marks them as resistant to Knock.

changes: Added native BG3 gameplay details with pinned item and linked rules evidence. Verified card mechanics against the cited item or linked rule.
